summary: Retested the 2 open items from iteration 23. Both are fixed. (1) client_ip spoofing: deps.client_ip now takes the right-most X-Forwarded-For hop (TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=1). A spoofed XFF of 1.2.3.4 or '1.2.3.4, 5.6.7.8' still stores the real ingress-seen IP 35.186.245.91. Rotating XFF across 6 bad logins gives 401x5 then 429, with one lock identifier. ADMS: a device with allowed_ips ['203.0.113.77'] rejects a cdata punch that sends XFF 203.0.113.77 (0 attendance rows). The same punch is accepted when allowed_ips holds the real IP, even with a spoofed XFF. Forgot-password also ignores a spoofed XFF. (2) Mobile Add Member with one plan, tested in a 390x844 Playwright session: two adds in a row both showed the 'Member added' toast and no 'Please select a membership plan' toast. Both members appeared in the list on the Solo plan. Regression: test_iter24_client_ip + test_iter23_audit_fixes + test_iter22_security_ledger, run with -n 0, gave 47/47 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: client_ip with TRUSTED_PROXIES='*' trusts any direct peer. That is fine only because the backend is reachable solely through the ingress. In production, set TRUSTED_PROXIES to the ingress CIDRs or set REAL_IP_HEADER, and match TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS to the real proxy chain. If a CDN like Cloudflare sits in front of the ingress, hops=1 would return the CDN edge IP for everyone, so use REAL_IP_HEADER=CF-Connecting-IP.
TRUSTED_PROXIES='*' with REAL_IP_HEADER set would trust a client-sent copy of that header unless the edge overwrites it. Document this.
attendance._device_by_sn calls _client_ip twice on the reject path. This is trivial.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with -n 0. Client IP as seen by the server from this container is 35.186.245.91. Tests learn it from the login_attempts identifier, which is '<ip>:<ident>'. Sending X-Forwarded-For no longer simulates a different client IP, so per-IP lock tests from one container share one IP. Keep the 15/IP forgot-password cap in mind.
